subject: ext-dy
title: EXT.DY.------SOC.RT.DY.
description: First of two diagrams in PR.S(RD)II-12. The following prose names the structural target: 'From early creative music (e.g., Louis Armstrong and Duke Ellington) until the present, western journalism has basically focused on the form and tools of the music as a means to interpret whether or not a given participation corresponds to an imposed definition of "real" (or correct).' The crossing diagrams how extended-dynamics structurally meets social-reality dynamics at the journalism's-form-and-tools-focus scale: EXT-DY (extended dynamics — the form's actual extended-working) crossed with SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics — the partner-axis's working social-reality). EXT-DY sits centrally with the subject-arrow; COS-P (cosmic-particulars) at upper-left and EXPM (expansionism) at top-center with SCI-DY (scientific dynamics) at upper-right as the partner-side upper outputs. WO-EXP-PRI (world-exposure principle) at left and RE-ST (restructuralism) right of WO-EXP-PRI as the bridging upper hubs. TRS (transformation) and INFO-SOLD (information-soldered) at center-right with (R)INTR (the reality of introduction) below as the partner-side downward chain. SOC-RT-DY anchors the lower-left margin as partner-axis. C-INFO (central information) and T-C-IMP (temporal-continuity implication) at center-bottom with STF (structural-formal) below as the bridging-axis downward terminus. Structural argument: when extended-dynamics is crossed with social-reality dynamics, the upper diagonal COS-P → EXT-DY → EXPM → SCI-DY is the *cosmic-to-scientific route* — cosmic-particulars route through extended-dynamics into expansionism and finally into scientific-dynamics on the partner-side. WO-EXP-PRI → RE-ST is the bridging upper hub: world-exposure-principle routes into restructuralism. SCI-DY → TRS → INFO-SOLD → (R)INTR is the partner-side downward chain — scientific-dynamics routes through transformation into information-soldered and finally into the reality of introduction. SOC-RT-DY at the partner-axis bottom is the partner's terminus. C-INFO → T-C-IMP → STF is the bridging-axis downward chain — central-information routes through temporal-continuity-implication into structural-formal. The structural argument: journalism's focus on form-and-tools as imposed definition of 'real' is structurally produced when the upper diagonal converts EXT-DY's working extension via EXPM into SCI-DY's scientific-dynamics — the form's actual extended-dynamics gets translated into scientific-form-measurement, which the partner-axis then converts through TRS → INFO-SOLD into the imposed reality of introduction. The form's structural-formal terminus (STF) on the bridging-bottom is what black creative music's actual structural form-and-tools point to — but journalism captures the upper diagonal before that bridging chain reaches social-reality dynamics directly.
